We once discussed veterinary medicine from the perspective of how humans came to the idea of helping other living creatures while spending their own time and resources on it. Strictly speaking, this mostly applies to pets, because in the industrial world veterinarians often work with farm animals. Today I want you to think about how incredibly complex this science really is. A veterinarian has to understand the anatomy and physiology of dozens of different species in order to help them. From a tiny aquarium fish to a massive python, any creature may need care, and it is honestly impressive how veterinarians manage to keep all of this knowledge in their minds while making decisions that can determine the fate of their patients. Veterinarians save tens of thousands of beloved pets and prevent epidemics among farm animals, which in many ways also means protecting human populations. Thank you, veterinarians. #Veterinarian #Medicine #Animals #edit #Pets

A standout shoyu ramen spot in Tokyo. Their signature menu is the “Special Shoyu Ramen.” Built on a chicken-based broth blended with multiple soy sauces, the first sip brings out the richness of chicken oil, deep umami from the soy sauce, and a subtle sweetness. As you continue, the flavors finish clean and balanced. The charcoal-grilled chashu adds a gentle smoky aroma that naturally melts into the broth✨ The straight noodles hold the soup well, delivering its flavor all the way through each bite. The chashu comes in a variety of cuts, each prepared differently—from rich, fatty pieces to lighter, more delicate textures—letting you enjoy a contrast of juiciness and mouthfeel. Raising Cane’s-Style Chicken Fingers With Cane’s Sauce. Ingredients: For the Chicken: - 2 lb chicken breast, cut into strips - Oil for frying For the Wet Batter: - 2 cups buttermilk - 2 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tbsp black pepper - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp smoked paprika For the Dry Batter: - 2 cups all-purpose flour - 3 tbsp cornstarch - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tsp black pepper - 1 tsp smoked paprika For the Cane’s Sauce: - 1 cup mayonnaise - 4 tbsp ketchup - 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 tbsp garlic powder - 1 tsp black pepper - Salt to taste - 1 tsp smoked paprika Instructions: 1. Prepare the wet batter by whisking together buttermilk, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. Add the chicken strips to the wet batter and marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight. 2. Prepare the dry batter by whisking together flour, cornstarch, salt, garlic powder, black pepper, and smoked paprika. 3. Remove the chicken from the wet batter, allowing excess to drip off, then coat each strip in the dry batter. 4. Deep-fry the coated chicken strips in hot oil (about 350°F) until golden brown and cooked through, approximately 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through. 5. Prepare the Cane’s Sauce by whisking together mayonnaise, ketchup,Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and smoked paprika. 6. Serve the crispy chicken fingers with Cane’s Sauce. #canessauce #raisingcanes #friedchicken #chickentenders #Recipe

CRISPY KOREAN CHICKEN PANCAKE (PADAKJEON) 🥢 The ultimate 20-minute comfort food. SAVE this for your next craving! 👇 🛒 Ingredients:  200g chicken breast (diced)  5 tbsp cornstarch (+ a splash of water)  1 bunch scallions (shredded)  ½ tsp each: garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper (plus salt to taste)  Neutral oil for frying Dipping Sauce: Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and chili oil. 🍳 How to Make It: 1 Marinate: Season diced chicken with salt, pepper, garlic, and onion powder. 2 Batter: Mix in cornstarch and a splash of water until well coated. 3 Fry: Pour into a hot, oiled pan. Spread evenly and fry both sides until golden and ultra-crispy. 4 Serve: Top with a mountain of shredded scallions and drizzle with the sauce! ✨ Follow for more easy eats! 🥞🌶️ #padakjeon #koreanfood #easyrecipesathome #koreanchicken #crispypancake

Chicken shawarma wrap 🌯 Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast/ thighs, cut into thin slices  1 tbsp fresh garlic, finely minced  2 tbsp mayonnaise  1 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp black pepper powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1/2 tsp coriander powder  1 tsp red chili powder  1/2 tsp turmeric powder  Salt to taste 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice  3 tbsp clarified butter/oil for cooking  For the sumac onions 1 large red onion, thinly sliced and washed  1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped  1 tbsp sumac  1 tsp lemon juice  Salt to taste For the garlic sauce : 1/3 cup mayonnaise  1/3 cup sour cream 3-4 tbsp butter milk ( less or more to adjust the consistency of the sauce ) 2 tbsp ketchup  2 tbsp hot sauce  1 tsp freshly chopped parsley  1 tsp lemon juice  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  To assemble: 6 tortilla wraps 1/2 cup cucumber, chopped  1/2 cup tomatoes, chopped  Spiced French fries 1/2 cup pickled cucumbers  Method: In a mixing bowl add chicken, season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika powder, turmeric, red chili powder. Add in the mayonnaise, garlic, oil and lemon juice. Mix until well combined. Cover and let it marinate for at-least 1 hour. Prepare the sauce by mixing mayonnaise, sour cream, buttermilk, salt pepper, paprika powder, garlic powder, hot sauce, lemon juice, ketchup in a bowl. Whisk until smooth and creamy.  Make the sumac onions by mixing onions, parsley , sumac, salt lemon juice in bowl. In a pan, heat clarified butter over medium heat. Once melted, add the chicken and cook in batches, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. Cook for about 8-10 minutes, tossing occasionally, until the chicken is fully cooked through. Assemble the wrap by warming the tortilla, then adding sauce, Sumac onions, chicken, tomatoes, cucumber, pickled cucumbers, French fries, and more sauce. Close it and serve one. #chickenwrap #Recipe #shawarma
